A LiFePO4 battery with BMS is a lithium iron phosphate battery with a built-in or external Battery Management System (BMS) that protects the battery and manages its operation.

What does the BMS do?

Overcharge protection: Prevents battery cells from exceeding safe voltage limits.

Over-discharge protection: Stops excessive discharge that could damage the cells.

Overcurrent protection: Limits excessive charging or discharging current.

Short-circuit protection: Disconnects the battery during a detected short circuit.

Cell balancing: Helps maintain consistent voltages across cells.

Temperature protection: Prevents charging or discharging outside specified temperature limits.
